e.title: **一个**把**美国死亡、**出生与**人口统计**做成**交互站点**、**并**把**数据快照**当**公开 **API** 发布的**项目****：`whywedie-mortality`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**An interactive site tracking US death, birth, and population statistics, sourced from CDC data.**」**；**⭐ 一条**架构选择**逐字**为**「**Two data strategies coexist on purpose**」**（**Socrata 浏览器直连** 对 **CDC WONDER 需**离线批处理**）**；**⭐ 其 **`/api`** 页逐字把 **`/data/*.json`** 说明为**「**public, CORS-open, read-only API**」**，**许可逐字 **CC0 1.0****；**⭐ 而**它**同时**逐字**承认 **CDC「**trims and stalls the datasets**」**、**且**某一**快照**仍**只是**占位****；**⚠️ 仓库**本身**未写许可证**
e.title_en: A project that turns United States death, birth, and population statistics into an interactive site and publishes the underlying data snapshots as an open interface: it describes itself in writing as an interactive site tracking those statistics sourced from national public health data, states that two data strategies coexist on purpose because one interface can be called straight from the browser while the other needs an out-of-band batch pipeline, documents its snapshot files as a public, cross-origin-open, read-only interface under a public domain dedication, and states plainly both that the upstream agency trims and stalls its datasets and that one snapshot remains a stub.
e.title_hk: **一個**把**美國死亡、**出生與**人口統計**做成**互動站點**、**並**把**數據快照**當**公開 API** 發布的**項目****：`whywedie-mortality`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**An interactive site tracking US death, birth, and population statistics, sourced from CDC data.**」**；**⭐ 一條**架構選擇**逐字**為**「**Two data strategies coexist on purpose**」**；**⭐ `/api`** 頁逐字把 `/data/*.json`** 說明為**「**public, CORS-open, read-only API**」**，**許可逐字 CC0 1.0**；**⭐ 而**它**同時逐字承認 **CDC「**trims and stalls the datasets**」**、**且**某一快照仍只是佔位**；**⚠️ 倉庫本身未寫許可證**
e.summary: **Why We Die**（`LeviDahl/whywedie`）**是一个**美国死亡、**出生与**人口统计的**交互站点****——**逐字自述为**「**An interactive site tracking US death, birth, and population statistics, sourced from CDC data.**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 创建 **2026-08-30****（**窗口内）**、**推送 **2026-09-07****、**仓库 **1,928 KB****、**主语言 **Vue****、**星标 **0****、**⚠️ 仓库**未写许可证****；**⭐ README **24,894 字节**／**414 行****；**⭐ 站点逐字为 **whywedie.org****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**自打标签的仓库**」**——**⭐ 本条**由 **`topic:mortality`** 一路取得**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **两种数据策略**逐字**「**并存是**故意的**」**（**`Two data strategies coexist on purpose`**）**——**⭐ 浏览器**直连 **Socrata（**纯 **JSON ＋**跨域**、**无需**后端）**对 **CDC WONDER（**XML／**POST、**无跨域、**仅**全国）**需**离线**批处理**；**② **它**直白**写出**上游的**问题**（**逐字**：**`CDC trims and stalls the datasets`**）**，**并**逐字说明**某个 **WONDER 快照**仍**只是占位**、**回退**到某个 **Socrata 数据集****；**③ **数据**以**公开 **API 形态**发布****（**逐字**：**`documents /data/*.json as a public, CORS-open, read-only API`**）**，**并**逐字注明**许可为 **CC0 1.0****；**④ **隐私页**逐字**写明**「**无 **cookie、**无广告、**无第三方请求**」**，**并**把**分析工具**标注为**「**计划中**」**而**不是**「**没有分析**」**——**⭐ 逐字**「**Keep it truthful**」**。**⚠️ 本次**未访问**其站点**、**未调用**其 **API**。
e.summary_hk: **Why We Die**（`LeviDahl/whywedie`）**是一個**美國死亡、**出生與**人口統計的**互動站點****——**逐字自述為**「**An interactive site tracking US death, birth, and population statistics, sourced from CDC data.**」**。**本次實測**：**⭐ 創建 2026-08-30（**窗口內**）**、**推送 2026-09-07**、**倉庫 1,928 KB**、**主語言 Vue**、**星標 0**、**⚠️ 倉庫未寫許可證**；**⭐ README 24,894 位元組／414 行**；**⭐ 站點逐字為 whywedie.org**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**自打標籤的倉庫**」**——**本條由 `topic:mortality`** 一路取得**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **兩種數據策略並存是故意的****（**逐字**Two data strategies coexist on purpose**）**；**② **直白寫出上游問題****（**逐字**CDC trims and stalls the datasets**）**，**並說明**某快照仍只是佔位**；**③ **數據以公開 API 形態發布****（**逐字**documents /data/*.json as a public, CORS-open, read-only API**）**，**許可逐字 CC0 1.0**；**④ **隱私頁逐字寫明**無 cookie、**無廣告、**無第三方請求**，**並把分析工具標為「**計劃中**」**——**逐字**Keep it truthful**。**⚠️ 本次**未訪問**其站點、**未調用**其 API**。
e.summary_en: This is an interactive site tracking United States death, birth, and population statistics sourced from national public health data. **Measured this round**: created on the thirtieth of August inside the window and pushed on the seventh of September, a repository of about two megabytes in Vue with no stars and no licence file at the repository level, a description of about twenty-five kilobytes over four hundred fourteen lines, and a live site. **This entry belongs to the round theme of self-tagged repositories and was reached through the mortality topic.** **Four things are worth reading: two data strategies coexist on purpose, because one interface serves plain data over cross-origin requests straight from the browser with no infrastructure while the other needs an out-of-band batch pipeline because it speaks a different protocol without cross-origin support and only publishes national figures; the project states plainly that the upstream agency trims and stalls its datasets and that one snapshot remains a stub, falling back to another dataset for the affected charts; the snapshots are published as an interface described in writing as public, cross-origin-open, and read-only, under a public domain dedication; and the privacy page states that there are no cookies, no advertising, and no third-party requests while describing aggregate analytics as planned rather than claiming there is none, with an instruction to keep the page truthful.** **The site was not visited and its interface was not called this round.**
e.body:
**Why We Die**（`LeviDahl/whywedie`）**是一个**美国死亡、**出生与**人口统计的**交互站点****——**逐字自述为**「**An interactive site tracking US death, birth, and population statistics, sourced from CDC data.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**自打标签的仓库**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 两种数据策略**并存**是**故意的**，**而**原因**逐字写清****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Two data strategies coexist on purpose**」**，**并逐字说明**：**一是 **Socrata（**`data.cdc.gov`）**，**逐字**为**「**plain JSON + CORS, browser-direct, no infrastructure**」**，**代价逐字**为**「**CDC trims and stalls the datasets**」**；**二是 **CDC WONDER**，**逐字**为**「**XML/POST, no CORS, national-only**」**，**故**逐字**需要**离线**管线**（**逐字**：**it is a scheduled batch job that writes static files**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 RIAA **最实用**：**⭐ 即**「**同一个**官方机构**的**数据**，**可以**通过**两条**技术路径**拿到**，**而**两条**路径的**能力与**代价**完全**不同**」**——**⭐ 把**这个**取舍**写进**文档**，**等于**把**后来者**会**踩的**坑**提前**填了**。

**⭐⭐ ② 上游**停更**与**占位**被**直白**写出****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**承认**某 **WONDER 快照**仍**只是**占位**（**逐字**：**still a stub**）**，**故**相关图表**回退**到 **Socrata 数据集 **`hmz2-vwda`**；**⭐ 并逐字说明**上游**在**某时间点后**停止**刷新**（**逐字**：**stopped refreshing it past June 2024**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一处**是**本轮**最值得**记**的**数据**态度**：**⭐ 即**「**我的**数据源**停更了**」**是**必须**写出来的**事实**，**而**不**是**可以**藏起来**的**瑕疵**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**任何**基于**外部**数据**的**分析**，**都**要**在**交付物**里**写明**「**这条**序列**到**哪一年**为止**」**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 数据**以**公开 **API** 形态**发布**，**许可**明确****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**：**`/api`** 页**把 **`/data/*.json`** 说明为**「**a public, CORS-open, read-only API**」**，**并**逐字注明**一个 **`.htaccess`** 规则**为 **`*.json`** 发送 **`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`**，**许可逐字为 **CC0 1.0****；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**一处**需要**分辨的地方**：**⭐ 即**「**站点**的**代码**」**与**「**数据**」**的**许可**可能**不同**——**⭐ 本条**逐字**只**看到**数据**的 **CC0** 声明**，**而**仓库**接口**的 **`license`** 字段**为空**（**⚠️ 本词条**因此**不**主张**代码**的**许可状态**）**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 隐私页**把**「**计划中**」**与**「**没有**」**分开**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**：**隐私页**声明**无 **cookie**、**无广告**、**无第三方请求**，**而**其中**「**分析**」**一节**逐字**说明**无 **cookie** 的**聚合分析**是**计划中**（**逐字**：**planned**）**，**而**不**是**「**没有分析**」**，**并**逐字写下**一句**内部**纪律**「**Keep it truthful — when an analytics tool ships, name it there.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**难得**：**⭐ 即**隐私声明**的**常见**失败**方式**是**把**「**现在**没有**」**写成**「**永远**没有**」**——**⭐ 而**它**把**将来**的**变化**位置**先**留好**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 站点**形态**与**数据面**（**逐字可核）**：**技术栈逐字为 **Vue 3（**Composition API）**、**Vite 8、**Vue Router 5、**Tailwind CSS v4、**Chart.js 与 **vue-chartjs、**`@unhead/vue`（**含 **JSON-LD 的 **`WebSite`／**`Dataset`／**`BlogPosting`）**、**`unplugin-vue-markdown`（**博客）**；**⭐ 逐字说明**站点**为**纯静态**（**逐字**：**The site itself is static — no server, no build-time data fetch.**）**，**并**逐字说明**快照**由**独立**的 **Node 管线**在**前端**之外**产出**（**逐字**：**its own `package.json`, never imported by the app**）**；**⭐ 数据**来源**逐字**到**数据集编号**（**含 **D74／**D16／**D76／**D176／**D192、**`w9j2-ggv5`、**`489q-934x`、**`y5bj-9g5w`、**`e6fc-ccez`**）**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[human-mortality-db]] 覆盖**人类死亡率数据库**、**[[cdc-wonder]] 覆盖**同一**数据源**的**查询入口**、**[[global-excess-deaths-mirror]] 覆盖**超额死亡**镜像**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**静态站点 ＋ **快照**API** 的**形态**再**发布**一次**死亡与**出生**统计**、**并**把**两条**取数路径的**取舍**写清**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **两种**取数路径**并存**时**要**写明**代价**；**② **上游**停更**与**占位**要**主动**披露**；**③ **把**数据**当作**可**调用**的**接口**发布**（**含**跨域头**与**许可**）**；**④ **代码**与**数据的**许可**要**分开**说明**；**⑤ **隐私**声明**要**区分**「**现在**没有**」与**「**计划**上线**」**；**⑥ **把**外部**管线的**依赖**与**前端**彻底**分开**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有访问**该站点**、**没有调用**其 **API**（**未取回**任何 **JSON** 快照）**，**故**不主张**其**任何**统计数字**、**也**不主张**其**接口**当前**可用**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **Vue** 源码**、**未读**其**管线**代码**。**③ ⚠️ 该仓库**接口的 `license` 字段为空****——**⭐ 而 **README** 逐字只**为**数据**声明 **CC0 1.0****；**⚠️ 本词条**因此**只**记录**数据**的**许可**，**不**主张**代码**的**许可状态**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**快照**与**上游**数据集**是否**数值**一致**（**⭐ 未**取回**快照**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**JSON-LD** 标注**与**实际**内容**是否**相符**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否为**任何**机构**或**项目**的**官方**成果**（**⭐ 逐字**只**自述**为**个人**站点**与 **GoDaddy** 部署**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该站点**是**公共**统计可视化**，**不是**死亡率**预测**，**也**不是**精算意见**。
e.body_hk:
**Why We Die**（`LeviDahl/whywedie`）**是一個**美國死亡、**出生與**人口統計的**互動站點****——**逐字自述為**「**An interactive site tracking US death, birth, and population statistics, sourced from CDC data.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**自打標籤的倉庫**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 兩種數據策略並存是故意的****——**逐字**「**Two data strategies coexist on purpose**」**；**其一逐字為**plain JSON + CORS, browser-direct, no infrastructure**（**代價逐字**CDC trims and stalls the datasets**）**；**其二逐字為**XML/POST, no CORS, national-only**，**故需**離線管線（**逐字**it is a scheduled batch job that writes static files**）**；**⭐ 即**同一機構的數據**可以**兩條路徑**取得**，**能力與代價完全不同**。

**⭐⭐ ② 上游停更與佔位被直白寫出****——**逐字**still a stub** 與 **stopped refreshing it past June 2024**；**⭐ 即**「**數據源停更了**」**是**必須寫出的事實**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 數據以公開 API 形態發布****——**`/api`** 頁逐字把 `/data/*.json`** 說明為**public, CORS-open, read-only API**，**`.htaccess`** 逐字為 **`*.json`** 發送 **`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`**，**許可逐字 CC0 1.0**；**⚠️ 而**倉庫介面 **`license`** 欄位為空**——**代碼**的許可**本條**不主張**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 隱私頁把「計劃中」與「沒有」分開****——**逐字**no cookies, no ads, no third-party requests**；**分析一節逐字說明**無 cookie 聚合分析是 **planned**，**並逐字寫下**「**Keep it truthful — when an analytics tool ships, name it there.**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 站點形態與數據面****——**技術棧逐字為**Vue 3、**Vite 8、**Vue Router 5、**Tailwind v4、**Chart.js 與 vue-chartjs、**`@unhead/vue`（**JSON-LD 含 `WebSite`／`Dataset`／`BlogPosting`）**、**`unplugin-vue-markdown`**；**逐字**The site itself is static — no server, no build-time data fetch.**，**快照由獨立 Node 管線產出**（**逐字**its own `package.json`, never imported by the app**）**；**數據集編號逐字含**D74／D16／D76／D176／D192、`w9j2-ggv5`、`489q-934x`、`y5bj-9g5w`、`e6fc-ccez`**。

**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[human-mortality-db]]、[[cdc-wonder]]、[[global-excess-deaths-mirror]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以靜態站點＋**快照 API** 再發布統計**、**並寫清兩條取數路徑的取捨**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **兩種取數路徑要寫明代價**；**② **上游停更與佔位主動披露**；**③ **數據當接口發布（**含跨域頭與許可**）**；**④ **代碼與數據許可分開說明**；**⑤ **隱私聲明區分「**現在沒有**」與「**計劃上線**」**；**⑥ **外部管線與前端徹底分開**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有訪問**該站點、**沒有調用**其 API**，**不主張**其任何統計數字與介面可用性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其 Vue 源碼與管線代碼**。**③ ⚠️ 該倉庫 `license` 欄位為空**；**README** 逐字只為**數據**聲明 **CC0 1.0****，**本詞條**不主張**代碼的許可狀態**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其快照與上游數據集是否數值一致**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其 JSON-LD 標註與實際內容是否相符**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否為任何機構的官方成果**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該站點是公共統計可視化**，**不是**死亡率預測**，**也**不是**精算意見**。
e.body_en:
This is an interactive site tracking United States death, birth, and population statistics sourced from national public health data. **This entry belongs to the round theme of self-tagged repositories.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, two data strategies coexist on purpose and the reason is stated in writing.** One is a plain-data interface with cross-origin support that the browser calls directly with no infrastructure, whose stated cost is that the agency trims and stalls its datasets, while the other speaks a different protocol without cross-origin support and publishes national figures only, which is why an out-of-band scheduled batch job writes static files instead of an always-on proxy. **The same agency data can be reached by two technical paths whose capabilities and costs differ completely, and writing that trade-off down in advance fills in the pit that a later reader would otherwise fall into.**

**Second, upstream stagnation and placeholders are stated plainly.** The description admits that one snapshot is still a stub, with the affected charts falling back to another dataset, and states that the upstream information system stopped refreshing that source past a date in 2024. **A stalled data source is a fact that has to be written out rather than a blemish to hide, and any analysis built on external data should say in the deliverable which year each series ends in.**

**Third, the data is published in the form of an open interface with an explicit licence.** One route documents the snapshot files as a public, cross-origin-open, read-only interface, with a server rule sending a wildcard cross-origin header for those files and a public domain dedication for the data. **This entry notes one distinction that matters: the licence of a site code and the licence of its data can differ, and since the repository interface reports no licence at all, only the data dedication is recorded here and no claim is made about the code.**

**Fourth, the privacy page separates what is planned from what is absent.** It states that there are no cookies, no advertising, and no third-party requests, while an analytics section describes cookieless aggregate analytics as planned rather than as not existing, and adds an internal rule to keep the page truthful by naming any analytics tool once it ships. **The usual failure of a privacy statement is writing now as forever, and this one leaves a named place for the future change.**

**Fifth, the site form and the data surface are both verifiable.** The stated stack is a current Vue setup with a fast build tool, routing, utility styling, charting, a head manager emitting structured data for the site, the dataset, and blog posts, and a Markdown pipeline for the blog. **The description states that the site is static with no server and no build-time data fetch, that the snapshots are produced by an independent pipeline with its own manifest that the application never imports, and it lists the upstream dataset identifiers behind each chart.**

**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a human mortality database, a query interface to the same upstream data source, and an excess-deaths mirror, **while this entry supplies the form of republishing death and birth statistics as a static site with a snapshot interface while documenting the trade-offs between the two retrieval paths. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: state the cost of each retrieval path when two coexist; disclose upstream stagnation and placeholders proactively; publish data as an interface including cross-origin headers and a licence; state code and data licences separately; distinguish what is absent from what is planned in a privacy statement; and keep external pipelines fully separate from the front end.**
